title: String of Pearls - 1x Mini Plug - Interesting Trailing House Plant
description: The product is a single String of Pearls plant plug, also known as a trailing houseplant. This indoor plant is in a vegetative growth stage with evergreen foliage, perfect for adding a touch of greenery to any room. Its common name, String of Pearls, refers to its cascading growth and pearl-like leaves, making it a unique and interesting addition to any garden or patio.
